title: Clear out the inbox
drDigitalIntro:
This is your assessment for this unit. There are no step-by-step instructions this time — just a list of things to accomplish.

- Nothing will glow yellow. You decide where to click.
- You can do the objectives in any order.
- Open the objectives list with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
- If you get stuck, the Hint button gives you a nudge — not the answer.

One email in this inbox is a scam. Find it yourself — I am not going to point at it.

playgroundTask.goal: You sorted the inbox on your own
playgroundTask.hint: Scam email leans on urgency and asks for something no real company asks for by email. Reply and Forward sit above an opened message. Attaching uses the paperclip.

steps.say: One of these emails is a scam. Move it to Spam.
Put a photo in it before you send.
You are finished with the Amazon shipping email but do not want to lose it. File it away.

drDigitalSuccess: You spotted the scam, answered a real message with an attachment, and filed what you were done with. That is inbox management.
drDigitalHint: Read the subject lines — one of them promises money. Open an email first; the buttons for replying, filing, and reporting appear once it is on screen.
